scope: API-PERF package A (1.1 translation index, 1.2 slim stop lookup, 1.4 routes?stopId from the stop index, 1.11 pooled connections): output equivalence with the previous SQL paths on a real generation, plus single-threaded query timings. Not an HTTP, container, load or Fargate measurement; not baseline -02.

provenance.baselineImplementation: services/api/src/opentransit/reference.py at 3d151b3 (PR #16 head before package A)
provenance.candidateImplementation: branch perf/api-t12-wave1 (package A + D, measured from the working tree; the committed reference.py differs only by formatting)
provenance.host: developer machine, Windows 11, native CPython 3.14.6, warm OS file cache

method: Opened the store with the manifest's reference digest as the attested SHA-256 (no PRAGMA integrity_check); the old implementation reused the same verified file and metadata.

Compared JSON text (key order included) of old vs new stop() by stop ID and by source ID for all 236 parent stations plus 800 random stops (seed 20261015); old stop()/route() cost too much to run on all 35,321 stops.
Compared stop_ref() by stop ID and by source ID with the new stop() for every stop.
Compared old vs new route() for 400 random routes, and routes(stopId=...) for every parent station plus 1,000 random stops, walking every page at limit 20.
Timed each call once, single-threaded, with the new store's result cache bypassed (private uncached methods).
Measured the in-memory indexes with tracemalloc on a separate build of the same structures.

routesStopQueryPlan: SEARCH rs USING COVERING INDEX route_stops_stop_idx (stop_id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

observations: routes?stopId now searches route_stops_stop_idx (covering) and routes by primary key; no table scan.

Natively with a warm file cache the old paths cost about 24-29 ms median; the Oct 3 baseline measured about 475 ms per translations query inside Docker on the demo stack. Re-measure through HTTP in baseline -02.
The translation index and stop lookup add about 33 MB (tracemalloc) to the API process per loaded generation; relevant to the H-0 API limit of 512 MiB (RSS 218 MiB measured Oct 1).
